## TL;DR

Round 1 landed the recency-on-hover behaviour for board and pipeline cards; round 2
fixes review feedback on touch. The shared `lib/tooltip.ts` delegate now supports
short tap and long-press on `data-tip` targets, keeps the tooltip open until the
user taps elsewhere, and no longer dismisses on touch `pointerdown` before the tip
can appear. Mouse hover, focus, and scroll-dismiss are unchanged.

## Work and rationale

Review round 1 correctly noted that card recency copied the existing global tooltip,
which only listened for mouse/focus and hid on every capture-phase `pointerdown`. On
touch that ordering prevented both long-press and tap from ever showing the styled
popover.

The fix stays in one place so TaskCard `.tc-hint`, PipelineCard `.pl-step--recency-tip`,
and every other `data-tip` site gain touch affordances together. Touch opens pin the
tooltip until an outside tap; tapping the same trigger again dismisses. A finger
moving beyond 12 px during a long-press cancels the timer. Non-touch `pointerdown`
still closes hover tips on outside click.

`touch-action: manipulation` on board hint and pipeline step selectors reduces the
browser double-tap delay. `tooltip-touch.test.ts` exercises long-press, short tap,
and dismiss via jsdom pointer events.

Round 1 items (inline recency removal, integration elapsed tip, shot routes on `/work`)
are unchanged on this tree.

## Approaches tried

Per-card `touchstart` handlers were rejected to avoid duplicating tooltip placement
logic. Radix popovers on each hint were heavier than extending the one body-level
`.app-tooltip` the app already uses.

## Challenges and blockers

Vitest had to preserve the singleton `.app-tooltip` node across cases because
`installTooltips` is idempotent; wiping `document.body.innerHTML` removed the popup
element while listeners stayed registered.

## Key learnings

When a global delegate owns `pointerdown` hide, touch-specific paths must either
skip hide for in-target presses or register a parallel open path; otherwise mobile
users never see delegated tooltips even though hover works on desktop.
